response.rationale: A and B describe the same capability: watching ice conditions and holding sessions when needed. "Ice safety monitoring" and "ice condition monitoring" mean the same thing here. Both are anchored on the same class, RinkService (node 21c65604dec116b1). A also includes TemperatureRepository (node 50b830f77ad06c02), the persistence class behind that monitoring, so A just shows the storage side as well. They are grouped differently (A by community:1, B by component:business), but that is a different view of the same code, not a different capability.
